headline: ChampionX lifts revenue; Mideast conflict weighs on profit
summary_short: SLB's Q2 2026 revenue rose 5% y/y to $8.97 billion on ChampionX and international growth, but GAAP EPS fell 30% y/y to $0.52 as Middle East conflict disruptions weighed on profitability.
summary_long: Revenue grew 3% sequentially and 5% year-on-year to $8.97 billion, with broad-based international growth — led by offshore activity in Latin America, Europe & Africa and Asia — offsetting a 13% sequential decline in the Middle East tied to the regional conflict. ChampionX contributed $870 million of revenue. GAAP net income fell 22% year-on-year to $786 million and diluted EPS fell 30% to $0.52, reflecting the Middle East disruption and $69 million of merger and integration charges; excluding charges, EPS was $0.55. SLB repurchased $648 million of stock during the quarter and generated $716 million of free cash flow. Full-year 2026 capital-investment guidance was reaffirmed at approximately $2.5 billion. Long-term debt rose to $11.14 billion from $10.89 billion y/y.
